exact_statement:
theorem main_pair :
    ∃ Φ₁ Φ₂ : Mat 10 → Mat 10,
      Φ₁ = phiOne ∧ Φ₂ = phiTwo ∧ PPT Φ₁ ∧ PPT Φ₂ ∧
      (let Z := choi (Φ₂ ∘ Φ₁)
       Z ≠ 0 ∧
       (∀ u v : Fin 10 → ℂ, ∀ w : Fin 10 × Fin 10 → ℂ,
         Z *ᵥ w = productVector u v → u = 0 ∨ v = 0) ∧
       ¬ EntanglementBreaking (Φ₂ ∘ Φ₁))
